import.no_company: Choose a company to import a file.
import.heading: What it is
import.required_note: A column marked with a star must be in the file, and filled in on every row.
import.mode_create: Create only: a row already known is refused.
import.mode_upsert: Create and update: a row already known is changed, and a blank cell keeps what is there.
import.preview_first: Preview first: nothing will be stored.
import.nothing_stored: Nothing was stored: fix the rows below and import the file again.

errors.network: The API cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_found: Nothing of the sort can be imported here, or you may not write it.
errors.invalid: The file could not be read.

refusals.unreadable: The file is neither a readable .csv nor a readable .xlsx.
refusals.unknown_columns: Unknown columns: {{columns}}. Start again from the template.
refusals.too_many_rows: The file is longer than {{limit}} rows. Split it into several files.

rejections.value_required: This cell must be filled in.
rejections.already_exists: Already there. Import in “create and update” to change it.
rejections.already_counted: This product already has stock at this location. Import in “create and update” to count it again.
rejections.duplicate_in_file: Already on line {{line}} of the file.
rejections.unknown_group: The company has no group named “{{name}}”. Create it first.
rejections.unknown_tax_code: The company has no tax coded “{{code}}”.
rejections.unknown_category: The company has no category named “{{name}}”.
rejections.unknown_expense_category: The company has no expense category named “{{name}}”.
rejections.unknown_product: The company has no product referenced “{{reference}}”. Import the products first.
rejections.unknown_location: The company has no stock location coded “{{code}}”. Create it first, under Stock.
rejections.ambiguous_location: Several establishments have a location coded “{{code}}”: rename one of them, or import one establishment at a time.
rejections.not_stocked: No stock is kept of this product: only goods whose stock is tracked are.
rejections.lot_tracked: “{{reference}}” is tracked by lot or serial number: count its opening stock under Stock, lot by lot.
rejections.invalid_quantity: Quantity refused: a number, within the unit's decimals.
rejections.invalid_payment_terms: Payment terms refused: a whole number of days.
rejections.identifier_required: This registration number is required under this regime.
rejections.identifier_shape: This registration number is not of the expected shape.
rejections.identifier_checksum: This registration number is misshapen: its check digit does not come out.

scan.failed: The scan could not be handled. Try again.
scan.not_editable: This document can no longer be changed: the scan adds nothing.
scan.retired: {{name}} is no longer sold: it is not added.
